# Changelog

All notable changes to this project are documented here. The format loosely follows
[Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/) and the project uses
[semantic versioning](https://semver.org/).

## [1.0.0] - 2026-11-23

First release as a package of its own. It was developed inside the repository of the application that
first used it, and its history comes with it.

### Added

- The dispatcher, middleware pipeline, system and self-drawn banner delivery, icon overrides, preference
  stores and appearance editor described in the README.
- A corner for each module, and optional grouping of notices that arrive together (off by default).
